title: QSR4: polynomial-space signed lower-order time and sample improvements

claims.statement: For QSR4 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME finite program (exhaustive n<2^24, short certified-log R=ell=ceil(log2n), m=ceil(T0/R) counted/hash/window table program otherwise) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its T=O(n^(63/2)(log2n)^(-1/2)2^(sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n)-2sqrt(n)(log2n)^(-1/2))), jointly with all resource bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. Source filters, failed attempts, full addressing/monitor generation, deterministic preprocessing and terminal cleanup are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2. Classical storage is O(n^3/log2n); all other classical buffers fit O(n^2).

For QSR4 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME finite program (exhaustive n<2^24, short certified-log R=ell=ceil(log2n), m=ceil(T0/R) counted/hash/window table program otherwise) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its S_C=O(n^3(log2n)^(-1)) bits, jointly with all resource bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. Source filters, failed attempts, full addressing/monitor generation, deterministic preprocessing and terminal cleanup are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 0. Classical storage is O(n^3/log2n); all other classical buffers fit O(n^2).

On EVERY branch its S_Q=O(n) qubits, jointly with all resource bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. Source filters, failed attempts, full addressing/monitor generation, deterministic preprocessing and terminal cleanup are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 0. Classical storage is O(n^3/log2n); all other classical buffers fit O(n^2).

For QSR4 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME finite program (exhaustive n<2^24, short certified-log R=ell=ceil(log2n), m=ceil(T0/R) counted/hash/window table program otherwise) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its Q=O(n^(3/2)sqrt(log2 n)2^((1/2)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n)-2sqrt(n)(log2n)^(-1/2))), jointly with all resource bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. Source filters, failed attempts, full addressing/monitor generation, deterministic preprocessing and terminal cleanup are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2. Classical storage is O(n^3/log2n); all other classical buffers fit O(n^2).

For the SAME QSR4 finite program in the evidence files, for every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N) and Q the ACTUAL number of source copies acquired including filters and discarded trees, the guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch including source/work aborts. No positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed-sample count among Q acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
